_comment: LAYER 1 — Require the golden-path reusable workflow to pass before merge on tier=production repos. Create via: gh api -X POST /orgs/ACME/rulesets --input rulesets/org-require-golden-path.json. Roll out with enforcement=evaluate (dry run) first, then flip to active. bypass_actors is intentionally EMPTY so no one (incl. admins/Copilot) can skip it.
